body:
Fixes #100

Release credentials could suppress all code checks on main, and several CI helpers could accept incomplete checks or hide the information needed to diagnose failures. This PR fixes all seven reported gaps.

| Issue item | Result | Automated regression |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 12 | Lint depends only on change detection; tests depend on detection and lint. Publishing still requires a successful preflight, and Pipeline Status still reports it. | `release-workflow-policy.test.mjs`, existing `pipeline-gate.test.mjs` |
| 7 | NuGet 401 fails as unauthenticated; 403 fails as authenticated without push authorization. Diagnostics include the quoted, key-redacted `x-nuget-warning` header. PR preflight remains advisory. | `nuget-auth.test.mjs`, `preflight-credentials.test.mjs` |
| 1 | Recovery and archive checks include Errors and Timeouts, validate report completeness, and reject runtime/configuration exit codes. Links are also checked weekly. | `link-failures.test.mjs`, `recheck-broken-links.test.mjs`, `links-workflow-policy.test.mjs` |
| 6 | Infrastructure reruns include Security. The policy test derives all workflows with terminal gates and checks the retry list. | `rerun-workflow-policy.test.mjs`, existing `runner-acquisition.test.mjs` |
| 3 | SARIF inspection collects every malformed run, diagnostic, and finding across files before failing. Reports name rules, locations, and messages; JSON quoting plus the existing command-suppression helper protect log output. | `security-gates.test.mjs`, `sarif-directory.test.mjs` |
| 5 | C#, `.mjs`, `.js`, and Markdown share a 900-line warning and 1000-line hard budget, excluding generated directories. | `check-file-size.test.mjs` |
| 11 | All 22 major-only action comments now name exact releases; the pin predicate rejects imprecise comments. | `action-pins.test.mjs` and existing workflow policy tests |

Reproduction: `bash experiments/issue-100/check-baseline.sh` runs the new regressions against the inspected original commit. It is expected to fail: the mixed recovered-503/timeout case incorrectly reports complete recovery before the fix, NuGet 403 remains advisory, and the other policies reject the original gaps. New helper APIs are also absent at baseline. The current branch passes these regressions. The complete requirement inventory is in `experiments/issue-100/README.md`.

Validation: pinned ESLint, Prettier, and checkJs pass; 154 focused offline helper tests and the expanded file-size gate pass. The full local helper suite reaches two package-validation failures because this container has SDK 10.0.112 while `global.json` requires 10.0.403. CI installs the pinned SDK and runs the complete helper suite, .NET builds/tests, package consumer checks, CodeQL, workflow lint, and link checks. CI on final commit `81ea47f` passes all 377 helper tests and the package consumer smoke test; .NET tests pass on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

Final-commit runs: [CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43401811037), [Security](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43401810968), [Workflows](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43401811084), [Links](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43401811092), and [Documentation](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43401810953).

A patch changeset prepares the automatic release. No package APIs or existing safety gates are removed. The Markdown budget deliberately uses the existing source-file budget; future documentation splits can follow the same threshold.
title: fix(ci): close credential, link, security and policy gate gaps
